name: Kami no Kuni no Mahoutsukai
source:
Main character comes with sister to Tokyo for a sightseeing trip. At a mysterious shrine they get back in time to Japan 1000 years ago. They start to get along with the villagers and even meet a cute wizard girl, so adventures begin!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2022/02/vn-of-month-january-2022-hentai-prison.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角和妹妹一起来东京观光。在一座神秘的神社，他们回到了1000年前的日本。他们开始与村民相处，甚至遇到了可爱的巫师女孩，冒险开始了！

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2022/02/vn-of-month-january-2022-hentai-prison.html]vndbreview[/url]]
